name: Manèges de Ya-Fé
description: Manèges de Ya-Fé is a popular family amusement area at the Palais des Congrès in Yaoundé, featuring bumper cars, carousels, spinning rides, a small roller coaster and electronic games.
bonASavoir: The rides are mainly aimed at families and children, although several attractions are suitable for adults. A ride has been reported at around 500 FCFA. The attraction is particularly active during weekends and festive periods.
